intent_record.intent_summary: Refactored simple_offset_rename to simplify error handling by converting to void return type with WARN_ON validation and removing conditional branching logic
intent_record.what: Changed function signature from int to void return type, replaced conditional branching based on new_offset with unconditional execution path, added WARN_ON validation check for new_offset being non-zero, updated documentation to specify caller must grab maple_tree slot
intent_record.how: Function now validates new_offset is non-zero before proceeding with early return on failure, removes old entry unconditionally, sets new offset to 0, and replaces entry with warning on failure instead of returning error codes to caller

intent_record.intent_summary: Refactored offset exchange implementation to use mtree storage instead of simple_offset functions with added index validation and simplified error handling
intent_record.what: Replaced simple_offset_remove/replace calls with mtree_store operations, added index validation check with WARN_ON, removed out_restore error handling label and rollback logic, simplified offset setting with offset_set calls
intent_record.how: Changes the internal data structure management from custom offset tracking functions to mtree storage, adds early validation to prevent NULL/zero index operations, removes complex error rollback paths in favor of simpler error propagation

intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes offset tracking cleanup logic in shmem_rename2 to prevent resource leaks when whiteout fails after offset addition
intent_record.what: Added simple_offset_add() call before RENAME_WHITEOUT check with error handling that sets had_offset flag on -EBUSY; modified error path to conditionally remove offset only if !had_offset; changed simple_offset_rename() from checked to unconditional call
intent_record.how: Ensures offset tracking is properly initialized before whiteout operation and cleaned up correctly if whiteout fails, preventing orphaned offset entries when -EBUSY indicates offset already exists
